text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hrawi supports a parliamentary move to cut by four months parliament's mandate.
- Maronite Patriarch Nasrallah Sfeir denounces "flagrant intervention" in Constitutional Council and General Labour Confederation (CGTL) affairs.
- Monitoring committee meets to discuss Lebanon's complaint against Israel.
- Constitutional Council to issue decisions by end of week on appeals against results of last summer's parliamentary elections.
- Heavy preparations underway for Pope's visit.
- Lebanese-Tunisian committee to follow up on issue of European-Mediterranean partnership.
- Beirut government bans opposition CGTL from celebrating Labour Day.
- Orthodox Archbishop Elias Audi questions Lebanese leaders' understanding of democracy.
- Government to abolish ministry of oil and keep ministry of industry.
